question: Who is designated in all respects for the purpose of the vidyā-body?
premises: A designation is made for the sake of the vidyā-body.
The designation applies in all respects.
The designated one is identified emphatically as Śiva.
inference: Śiva alone is designated in all respects for the purpose of the vidyā-body.
plain_english: For the purpose of the vidyā-body, it is Śiva alone who is designated in all respects.
